note: Single source of truth for every tunable (spec section 12). Structural params need a world rebuild and are locked once a world exists.

params.desc: Master seed. Every subsystem RNG stream is derived from it.
Map width in cells.
Map height in cells.
Approximate count of large elevation features (continents) across the longer side of the map.
Fractal octaves for elevation noise. More octaves = rougher coastlines.
Frequency multiplier between elevation octaves.
Amplitude multiplier between elevation octaves.
Approximate count of wet/dry regions across the longer side of the map.
Fractal octaves for moisture noise.
Frequency multiplier between moisture octaves.
Amplitude multiplier between moisture octaves.
Normalized elevation below which a cell is water (ocean).
Elevation band above sea level that becomes sand (mud if wet).
Normalized elevation above which a cell is rock (outcrops, uplands).
Moisture above which low and mid land floods into lakes.
Lakes only form below this normalized elevation.
Moisture above which lowland becomes mud.
Mud only forms below this normalized elevation (the wet beach band aside).
Moisture below which land becomes sand.
Extra moisture right at the coast, fading with elevation above sea level.
Elevation above sea level over which the coast moisture bonus fades to zero.
Share of fertility driven by moisture; the rest is the fertility_base of the substrate alone.
Sim ticks per second at 1x speed. Other speeds are multiples of this.
Threads for parallel sim phases. 0 = one per logical core, 1 = single-threaded. Results are identical for any value.
Work chunks per thread in parallel phases (load balancing granularity).
Below this many items a phase runs single-threaded (threading overhead would dominate).
Sim ticks per in-game hour.
Hours per in-game day.
Days per season. A year is always 4 seasons (spring, summer, autumn, winter).
Share of the day that is daylight in spring.
Share of the day that is daylight in summer.
Share of the day that is daylight in autumn.
Share of the day that is daylight in winter.
Share of the day over which light ramps at dawn and at dusk.
Light level at night (1 = full daylight). Drives the day/night factor other systems read.
Run the sampled environment pass (moisture, fertility, flora) each tick.
Fraction of all cells updated per tick by the sampled environment pass.
Horizontal bands the pass is split into (even bands, then odd bands, each in parallel). Fixes the random layout, so results do not depend on thread count; changing it changes results.
Cells per side of one climate grid block (the low-res base moisture field).
Base moisture of the driest climate block.
Base moisture of the wettest climate block.
Per day, the share of the gap to the climate target that moisture closes (evaporation/rain balance).
Per day, the share of the gap to the neighbour average that moisture closes. Water tiles are fixed at full moisture, so they act as sources.
Moisture target offset in spring.
Moisture target offset in summer.
Moisture target offset in autumn.
Moisture target offset in winter.
Weather: random rainy days raise the moisture target.
Probability that a given day is rainy (map-wide).
Rain raises the moisture target by rain_moisture times the share of rainy days in this many recent days.
Moisture target boost when every recent day was rainy.
Per day, the share of the gap to the natural fertility level (substrate base x moisture) that fertility closes. Stands in for nutrient cycling until decomposition exists (Phase 3).
Fertility at or above which growth is not fertility-limited; growth scales linearly below it.
Below this fertility, plants lose biomass instead of growing.
Share of max biomass lost per day while starving.
A plant wilts when moisture is below moisture_need times this.
Share of max biomass lost per day while wilting.
Chance a seed fails to establish, per neighbouring plant of the same type (Janzen-Connell effect). Lets types coexist instead of the fastest colonizer taking all shared habitat.
Biomass of a newly established seedling.
Fertility units (of 255) drained per biomass unit harvested.
Ticks between decisions per entity, staggered by entity slot. An entity whose action finished decides on the next tick regardless.
Size of each entity's memory ring (the memory_capacity gene uses at most this many).
Cells per side of the perception blocks used to find corpses and water (only blocks that have any are read cell by cell).
Remembered locations are forgotten after this many days.
Seek-remembered-food utility relative to foraging food in sight (scaled further by memory freshness).
Biomass harvested per tick of eating (the harvest call amount).
Derived base burn (spec 4.1.1), energy per tick: the part every entity pays whatever its genome. Calibrated so the default genome burns 0.6.
Base burn per 1000 of max_energy (carrying reserves costs).
Base burn per move_speed squared (a faster body costs even at rest).
Base burn per unit of digest_efficiency.
Base burn per memory slot (the memory capacity the entity actually gets).
Base burn per 100 of max_hp.
Perception cost, energy per tick per scanned cell: sense_burn = this x (2 x sense_radius + 1)^2. Default = the old linear cost at radius 5 (0.02 x 5) / 121 cells.
Derived move cost (spec 4.1.1), energy per cell on cost-1 terrain: the part every entity pays. Calibrated so the default genome pays 0.4.
Move cost per move_speed squared.
Base burn multiplier while resting.
Food quality q = rate / (rate + burn x this), where rate is the expected energy per tick (bite gain over travel + eating time). Low-value food scores low next to better food.
Wander utility = explore x (wander_base + wander_hunger x hunger) when no food is in sight; explore x wander_base otherwise. A remembered food cell does not lower it; it adds the seek option.
How much hunger raises wander utility when no food is in sight.
Local path choice: weight of the next cell's terrain move cost against progress toward the target (0 = ignore terrain).
Ticks in a row a move toward a target may be blocked before the entity gives that target up (and will not pick it again until it gets stuck elsewhere).
Entities in sight at which crowding counts as full (crowd = min(1, entities in sight / this)).
Added to wander utility at full crowding; a crowded wanderer that is not searching heads away from the crowd.
Above this hunger, with no food in sight, a wanderer searches: it keeps its heading (a straight line), crowd or not, and turns only when blocked.
Speed multiplier while carrying a corpse.
Move cost multiplier while carrying a corpse (per cell, on top of terrain cost).
Carrying time after which the urge to drop a corpse is full.
Drop utility = drop_weight x min(1, carried time / carry_days) + hunger.
Probability a new entity is female (sex is assigned but unused until reproduction, Phase 4).
Whether entities may eat corpses (spec open item; off by default).
Mass of a fresh corpse.
Energy per unit of corpse mass eaten, before digest_efficiency. The corpse counterpart of item nutrition.
Corpse mass eaten per tick of eating.
Days a corpse lies before it has decayed completely. Carried corpses do not decay.
Fertility units (of 255) a corpse releases per unit of mass while decaying, spread over the cells within spread_radius.
Chebyshev radius of the land cells a decaying corpse fertilises.
Ticks between corpse decay updates.
Founder groups spawned by the founder spawner (spec section 1).
Smallest founder group.
Largest founder group.
Minimum distance (cells) between founder group centres. Relaxed if a centre cannot be placed.
Radius (cells) around a group centre within which its founders are placed; grows if too crowded.
A founder group centre must be on a cell with at least this fertility (habitable land, not bare rock or sand).
Founders start with energy uniform in [this, 1] x max_energy, so their hunger is not synchronised.
Per-founder gene jitter: uniform +/- this share of each gene's range around the default (0 = exact defaults).
Most zoomed-out camera scale (screen pixels per cell).
Most zoomed-in camera scale (screen pixels per cell).
Zoom factor per mouse wheel notch.
Exponential smoothing rate for zoom (per second). 0 = instant.
Keyboard pan speed in screen pixels per second.
Opacity of data overlays drawn over the terrain.
In the windowed app, when sim.worker_threads is 0 (auto), leave this many cores free for the main/render thread. Headless runs use every core.
Max samples per axis when a screen pixel spans several cells (anti-shimmer when zoomed out). 1 = point sampling.
Minimum on-screen size of an entity point, so entities stay visible when zoomed out.
Colour entity points by sex at startup instead of by energy (toggle in the HUD).
How often the renderer pulls entity positions from the sim.
How often visible dynamic layers (flora, fertility, moisture) are re-copied from the sim and re-uploaded. Each copy is 16 MB per layer at 4096x4096.
Tint flora by season at startup (toggle in the HUD).
Darken the world by time of day at startup (toggle in the HUD).
Default radius of the debug flora brush, in cells.
HUD stats refresh rate.
